$description: Needt design tokens — extracted by port/tools/extract-tokens.js from the DS bundle tokens + themes.css + app.css + styles/*.css. $value = the light theme; $extensions['app.needt'].modes holds every mode the token is declared in (light, dark, warm, dim, reduced-motion, accent:<id>:light|dark). Do not edit by hand — regenerate.

control-h.$description: nav row, button, command bar, select, input

hour-h.$description: one hour on the day timeline; a block's height is its duration

curve.$description: Named curves from MOTION.md § Curves (aliases used in prose; the CSS writes them literally or via --ease-pop / --nx-ease / --chat-*).

scale.$description: The duration scale (MOTION.md § Motion tokens). Anything else is off-scale (MOTION.md § Violations D).

font-mono.$value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

modes.light: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

text-ui.$description: 400 and 500 / 16 — every control, nav row, button, chip

radius-floating.$description: the floating action, and only that

radius-md.$description: nav rows, icon buttons, tabs, chips — the workhorse

radius-sheet.$description: the document sheet — largest in the product

blur.$description: Observed blur radii (literal blur(Npx) in the live CSS / JSX — backdrop-filter glass, fog, sky, doc backdrop 22px). No --blur-* tokens exist yet; count = occurrences. Reference only (not in tokens.css).
